summary: A story-rich detective RPG mixing visual novel adventure with action combat!
description:
FREE FIRST CHAPTER - Unlock the full game with a single Premium purchase or Google Play Pass!

BROK is an innovative adventure mixed with beat 'em up and RPG elements. In a grim world where furry animals have replaced mankind, what kind of detective will you be?

In a futuristic "light cyberpunk" world where animals have replaced humans, privileged citizens live under a protective dome from the ambient air pollution while others struggle to make a living on the outside.

Brok, a private detective and former boxer, lives with Graff, the son of his deceased wife. Although he could never elucidate her accident, recent events may shed some light on an even more tragic outcome... one that may be linked to their own existence. 
Will they be able to withstand the threats of this corrupted world and face their own destiny? 

--------------------
FEATURES
--------------------
- Solve puzzles with your wits... or muscles!
- Make choices impacting gameplay and/or story
- Deep visual novel narrative with multiple choices
- Relaxed mode for pure "Point & Click" gameplay (fights can be skipped)
- Level up to beat enemies and bosses
- Combine clues to uncover the truth!
- In-game hints
- Two playable characters, switch at any time
- 15 to 20 hours long on first playthrough 
- Multiple distinct endings to unlock 
- Fully voice acted (23,000 lines)
- Full accessibility for blind players
- Optimized for touch screens (fight using touch swipes or virtual buttons)
- Compatible with most Bluetooth controllers
- Play the adventure with friends in local co-op (up to 4 players)
- Text fully translated into 10 languages

---------------------------------
WHY YOU'LL LOVE BROK
---------------------------------
• A DEEP, STORY-RICH DETECTIVE MYSTERY: Immerse yourself in a gripping visual novel narrative set in a dark cyberpunk world with an unforgettable cast.

• CLASSIC ADVENTURE MEETS BEAT 'EM UP ACTION: Solve clever point-and-click puzzles using your brain, or brawl your way through tough encounters with your fists!

• MULTIPLE ENDINGS DRIVEN BY YOUR CHOICES: Every investigation matters—your decisions shape the outcome of the story across multiple distinct conclusions.

• FULLY VOICE-ACTED CAST: Enjoy over 20,000 lines of fully voiced dialogue bringing the dystopian world and its characters to life.

• PLAY YOUR WAY: Switch seamlessly between a relaxed story puzzle experience and challenging hardcore brawler gameplay anytime.
esrbNotes: Fantasy Violence, Mild Blood, Alcohol Reference
